title: coleus recurvata
intro: Coleus recurvata, commonly known as Coleus, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus recurvata include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Coleus recurvata include compounds like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
